  *****NOTE FROM THE CITY*****

Doors to the City Council Chamber will open at 12:40 p.m. for Closed Session and 1:30 p.m. for
Open Session. Please be mindful that seating is limited and available on a first come, first served
basis.
The City provides the following methods for the public to view, listen to, and participate in City Council
meetings:
In-Person Attendance
 Members of the public may attend and participate in the meeting in person at the City Council Chamber.
Meeting Broadcasts
 The City also provides the following additional viewing options as a convenience:

  Spectrum Cable Channel 35 (audio and limited video). Please check with your cable provider for
  details.
  Live online through Facebook Live (audio and limited video) at:
https://www.facebook.com/cityofinglewood/
Remote Participation
 Members of the public may also attend and participate remotely through Zoom or telephone using the
following method:

  Online: https://inglewood.zoom.us/j/83282399789
  Telephone: (669) 900-6833
  Meeting ID: 832 8239 9789
  Passcode: 90301
Public comments may be provided in person or remotely during the designated public comment periods in
accordance with the meeting procedures established by the presiding officer.
Disruptions to Remote Access
In accordance with applicable law and City Council policy, if a disruption occurs that prevents the public
from accessing the meeting through the City's remote participation platform, the City Council may recess
the meeting and take appropriate steps to restore access before proceeding.
Submitting Comments Prior to Public Meeting: Members of the public may choose to submit comments
electronically for consideration by the City Council or other City Legislative Body by sending them to the
 City  Clerk/Secretary  at  athompson@cityofinglewood.org,  and  Deputy  City  Clerk
at dwesley@cityofinglewood.org. To ensure distribution to the members of the Legislative Body prior to
consideration of the agenda, please submit comments prior to 8:00 a.m. the day of the meeting, and in the
body of the email, please identify the agenda number or subject matter. Correspondence should indicate the
meeting date and agenda item. Comments received after 8:00 a.m. and prior to the close of the public
hearings will be made part of the official public record of the meeting. Contact the Office of the City Clerk
at 310-412-5280 with any questions.

Accessibility: If requested, the agenda and backup materials will be made available in appropriate
alternative formats to persons with a disability, as required by Section 202 of the Americans with
Disabilities Act of 1990 (42 U.S.C. Sec. 12132), and the federal rules and regulations adopted in
implementation thereof. Any person who requires a disability-related modification or accommodation, or
translation services in order to observe and/or offer public comment may request such reasonable
modification, accommodation, or service by contacting the Office of the City Clerk by telephone at 310-
412-5280, FAX at 310-412-5533, One Manchester Boulevard, First Floor, Inglewood City Hall,
Inglewood, CA 90301 or via email
to athompson@cityofinglewood.org and dwesley@cityofinglewood.org no later than 24 hours prior to the
scheduled meeting.

DR-3 & H-3. HOUSING SERVICES & CDBG DEPARTMENT

  Staff report recommending the Mayor/Chairman and Council/Housing Authority Members
  authorize transactions and agreements for the refinance and partial repayment of the
  Inglewood Redevelopment Agency Loan (“Agency Loan”) with Regency Towers Senior
  Housing, L.P. (“Owner”), for the property located at 151 North Locust Street Inglewood, CA
  90301 (“Project”).
  Recommendation:
  ​
  1. Authorize the following transactions and agreements:
  a. Approve a partial repayment of approximately $2,297,878 in net capital
  proceeds from the refinancing transaction;
  b. Re-subordinate the City’s new loan and affordability covenants to a new
  first mortgager;
  c. Modify and restate the current loan to reflect a principal amount equal to
  the remaining unpaid principal at the current 3% interest rate;
  d. Execute the new Low-and Moderate-Income Housing Funds (LMIHF)
  subordinate loan agreement;
  e. Execute an Amended Promissory note; and
  f. Approve and execute the Amended and Restated Regulatory Agreement
  extending affordability covenants;
  2. Adopt a resolution amending the Fiscal Year 2025-2026 Operating Budget to
  receive approximately $2,297,878 in net capital proceeds (Low-and Moderate
  Income Housing Funds);
  -AND-

  3. Allow the Mayor/Chairman or his designee to sign additional implementation
  documents reasonably necessary for the refinance, repayment, and execution of
  the new loan agreement.
  Documents:

  DR-3, H-3.PDF

DR-4 & H-4. HOUSING SERVICES & CDBG DEPARTMENT

  Staff report recommending the Mayor/Chairman and Council/Housing Authority Members
  approve development agreements and contract with Sankofa Place, LP (Owner) for the
  development of a new 120-unit affordable rental housing community located at 400–410
  Centinela Boulevard, Inglewood, California 90302 (“Project”).
  Recommendation:
  ​
  1. Approve the following development agreements and contract with Sankofa
  Place, LP (Owner):
  a. HOME Investment Partnerships Program Loan Agreement
  (“HOME-ARP”) in the amount of $2,800,000 funded through an
  award from the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban
  Development (“HUD”), Office of Community Planning and
  Development (“CPD”);
  b. Regulatory agreement and Declaration of Restrictive Covenants
  (Density Bonus and SB35) requiring forty-one (41) affordable
  housing units to remain income-restricted for a minimum period of
   fifty-five (55) years, consistent with California Density Bonus Law;
  and
  c. HUD Section 8 Project-Based Voucher Program Agreement to enter
  into a Housing Assistance Payments Contract (“AHAP”) and the
  Housing Assistance Payments Contract (“HAP Contract”),
  authorizing the Inglewood Housing Authority (IHA) to provide
  rental assistance payments for up to fifty-nine (59) eligible
  households for a term of up to twenty (20) years pursuant to HUD’s
  Project-Based Voucher Program;
  -AND-

  2. Adopt a resolution to authorize the Mayor/Chairman, or designee, to
  execute any additional agreements, certifications, amendments, and
  implementation documents necessary to facilitate the development and
  completion of the Project.
  Documents:

  DR-4, H-4.PDF

  *****NOTA DE LA CIUDAD*****

Las puertas del Salón del Concejo Municipal se abrirán a las 12:40 p. m. para la sesión a puerta
cerrada y a la 1:30 p. m. para la sesión pública. Tenga en cuenta que el aforo es limitado y los
asientos se asignarán por orden de llegada.
La ciudad ofrece los siguientes métodos para que el público pueda ver, escuchar y participar en las
reuniones del Ayuntamiento:
Asistencia presencial:
 Los miembros del público pueden asistir y participar en la reunión en persona en la Sala del Ayuntamiento.
Retransmisiones de reuniones
 La ciudad también ofrece las siguientes opciones de visualización adicionales para su comodidad:

  Canal 35 de Spectrum Cable (audio y video limitado). Consulte con su proveedor de cable para
  obtener más detalles.
  Transmisión en vivo en línea a través de Facebook Live (audio y video limitado) en:

Los comentarios del público podrán presentarse en persona o de forma remota durante los períodos
designados para ello, de acuerdo con los procedimientos de la reunión establecidos por el presidente.
Interrupciones en el acceso remoto
De conformidad con la legislación aplicable y la normativa del Ayuntamiento, si se produce una
interrupción que impida al público acceder a la reunión a través de la plataforma de participación remota de
la ciudad, el Ayuntamiento podrá suspender la reunión y tomar las medidas oportunas para restablecer el
acceso antes de continuar.
 Envío de comentarios antes de la reunión pública: Los miembros del público pueden enviar sus
comentarios electrónicamente para que el Concejo Municipal u otro órgano legislativo de la ciudad los
considere, enviándolos al Secretario Municipal a athompson@cityofinglewood.org y al Secretario
Municipal Adjunto a dwesley@cityofinglewood.org . Para garantizar la distribución a los miembros del
órgano legislativo antes de que se considere el orden del día, envíe sus comentarios antes de las 8:00 a. m.
del día de la reunión e indique en el cuerpo del correo electrónico el número del orden del día o el asunto.
La correspondencia debe indicar la fecha de la reunión y el punto del orden del día. Los comentarios
recibidos después de las 8:00 a. m. y antes del cierre de las audiencias públicas se incorporarán al registro
público oficial de la reunión. Para cualquier pregunta, comuníquese con la Oficina del Secretario Municipal
al 310-412-5280.

adoptados para su implementación. Cualquier persona que requiera una modificación o adaptación
relacionada con la discapacidad, o servicios de traducción para observar y/o ofrecer comentarios públicos,

Primer Piso, Ayuntamiento de Inglewood, Inglewood, CA 90301 o por correo electrónico a

reunión programada.

COMENTARIOS DEL PÚBLICO SOBRE OTROS ASUNTOS

 Quienes deseen dirigirse al Ayuntamiento sobre cualquier asunto relacionado con la administración
 municipal que no esté contemplado en el orden del día, podrán hacerlo en este momento. Se ruega a
 quienes tengan quejas sobre la gestión municipal o las operaciones departamentales que las presenten
 primero al administrador municipal para su resolución.
DECLARACIONES DEL ALCALDE Y DEL CONCEJO
 Los miembros del Ayuntamiento presentarán informes orales, incluidos informes sobre viajes relacionados
 con la ciudad en los que se incurra en gastos de alojamiento, y/o abordarán cualquier asunto que
 consideren de interés general para el público.

APLAZAMIENTO DEL CONCEJO MUNICIPAL
 En caso de que la reunión del Ayuntamiento de hoy no se celebre o concluya antes de que se considere
 una audiencia pública u otro punto del orden del día, dicho punto se pospondrá automáticamente para la
 siguiente reunión ordinaria del Ayuntamiento. Si necesita adaptaciones especiales debido a una
 discapacidad, comuníquese con la Oficina del Secretario Municipal al (310) 412-5280 o por fax al (310)
 412-5533, One Manchester Boulevard, Primer Piso, Ayuntamiento de Inglewood, Inglewood, CA 90301.
 Todas las solicitudes de adaptaciones especiales deben recibirse con 72 horas de anticipación al día de las
   reuniones del Ayuntamiento.

* No se adjunta informe del personal en el momento de la impresión.
